players.bio: Aaron Bradley Loupalo-Bi (born 7 November 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town, on loan from Premier League club Fulham.

Adam Murphy (born 8 April 2005) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for League 2 club Fleetwood Town on loan from Championship club Bristol City. He previously played for St Patrick's Athletic, where he started his professional career and Swindon Town.
Andrew Francis Cannon (born 14 March 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town
Calum Costello is a 20-year-old Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for English club Fleetwood Town FC.

Chedwyn Michael Evans (born 28 December 1988) is a Welsh footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. Born in Rhyl, Evans was signed by Manchester City from Chester City's youth set up in 2002 and he subsequently progressed through the ranks.

Conor Haughey is a professional footballer from Northern Ireland who plays as a center-back for English League Two club Fleetwood Town F.C.. Born in Belfast on May 29, 2007, he achieved early recognition by becoming the youngest-ever player to feature for Glentoran's first team at just 15 years old.
Crispin Robert McLean (born 30 September 2006) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town.

Daniel Kenny Andrew (born 23 December 1990) is an English footballer, who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. Predominantly a left-back, Andrew can also operate at centre-back, often in a back three. Andrew is a free kick specialist.

Finley Potter (born 14 March 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. Career Potter came through the academy of Sheffield United, being rewarded with a scholarship deal in August 2020. His deal started in unfortunate circumstances, missing eighteen months through injury before his return to action in February 2022.
Harrison Francoiś Neal (born 12 May 2001) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town.
Jake Thomas Batty (born 4 May 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back, left wing-back or left winger for League Two side Fleetwood Town.
James Pradic is a 21-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Fleetwood Town F.C. in EFL League Two.
Jay Anthony Lynch (born 31 March 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town.

Jesse Dempsey is a 21-year-old Irish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Fleetwood Town. He joined the EFL League Two club on 31 July 2026 on a season-long loan deal from their League of Ireland sister club, Waterford FC.

Joshua John Thomas (born 24 September 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town . He is a former Wales under-21 international. He will become a free agent on 30 June 2026. A pacey forward capped by Wales up to under-21 level, Thomas turned professional at Swansea City in 2020.
Kane Angelis Gavin Thompson-Sommers (born 1 December 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town
kayden hughes (born 28 November 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a Defender for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town.
Lewis McCann (born 7 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as forward for Fleetwood Town. Born in Scotland, he has represented Northern Ireland at youth international level.
Mark David Helm (born 21 October 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town.

Matthew Lawlor (born 20 August 1988) is an English football manager and former player. He is the current manager of EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. As a player, he played as high as the Conference National for Farsley Celtic. As a coach, he held numerous roles at Fleetwood and League of Ireland Premier Division partner club Waterford, including several spells as caretaker manager of both.

Nathan Louis Pond (born 5 January 1985) is a retired professional footballer who played as a defender or defensive midfielder. He is currently assistant head coach at Fleetwood Town. He has previously played for Fleetwood Town over a fifteen-year period, whilst also having spells with Lancaster City, Kendal Town, Grimsby Town, Salford City, AFC Fylde and AFC Telford United.

Oliver Bellizia is a English professional football player who plays as a goalkeeper for Fleetwood Town F.C.. Bellizia originally progressed through the youth academies at Birmingham City and Nottingham Forest before joining Fleetwood Town in January 2023. After an impressive stint anchoring the Under-18s, he signed his first professional contract with the club in the summer of 2025.
Raffaele Alexander Cirino (born 3 February 2007) is a footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. He represents the Montserrat national team.
Rhys Joseph Wright Bennett (born 30 October 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town.

Ronan Liam Coughlan (born 2 October 1996) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. He previously played for Bray Wanderers, Cork City, Sligo Rovers, St Patrick's Athletic and Waterford.

Shaun Antony Rooney (born 26 July 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Fleetwood Town. He has previously played for Queen's Park, Dunfermline Athletic, York City, Queen of the South, Inverness Caledonian Thistle, St Johnstone, St Mirren and another spell at Fleetwood.
William James Davies (born 7 June 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Fleetwood Town.
